holds.description: Whether the bundle serves the key: every condition of cli-spec.md §5.10 holds.

bundle_key.description: The bundle's own key, `bundle_key` of its manifest: what the backend's alias row points to.

revision_key.description: The revision key asked about, `revision_key` of the `--key-record`.

failure.description: The first failing condition. Present exactly when `holds` is false.

description: stdout of `bundle reuse` (exit 0 whether or not the read set holds; cli-spec.md §5.10).
title: prism-kicad bundle reuse result a0

Sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest: exactly 64 characters, no prefix such as `sha256:`.

condition.description: The first condition, in the order of this enum, that failed.

path.description: The repository path the condition failed on, the first in code point order; absent for `config`, `generator` and `model-unavailable`.

CliReuseFailure.description: Why a read set does not hold.

CliReuseCondition.description: The condition of `bundle reuse` that failed first (cli-spec.md §5.10, ADR amendment K2 §3.3).

RepoPath.description:
Repository-relative POSIX path, exactly as `git ls-tree` names the entry:
`/`-separated, case preserved, no leading `/`, no empty, `.` or `..`
segment, no backslash and no `:`. The same character rule as ArchivePath.
It is the only path type in bundle documents: a file has one spelling
whichever project in the repository refers to it, and a file outside the
project directory needs no `..`.
